summary: Mid-rise market-rate residential block between Maryland and Delaware streets, south of Humboldt St and north of Power Station Park East, approved March 2, 2022 for a Foster + Partners-designed 14-story, approximately 125-ft, 339-unit building with about 18,000 sq ft of retail; in August 2026 JPMorgan Chase agreed to finance roughly $200 million for a 342-unit building at 151 Humboldt St, with construction expected to begin in fall 2026.

milestones.text: Phase 1 Development Phase Application approved: Block 8 to include approximately 315 market-rate units (approximately 359,000 sq ft primarily residential, 5,000 sq ft retail, 49,000 sq ft accessory parking)
Design review pre-application community meeting for Blocks 7 and 8
Design Review Application for Block 8 submitted (Case 2017-011878PHA-06)

SF YIMBY reports new design-review applications: Block 8 described as 140 ft with 249 units, six retail spaces, wellness center, pool and an eighth-floor urban farm; the article itself states that Block 8 would begin rising in 2026 and complete in 2028

Planning Director approves the Block 8 design review: 14 stories (12 habitable), approximately 125 ft plus rooftop features, 339 units, approximately 18,000 sq ft retail, 166 vehicle spaces; one minor modification to D4D A.8.1 (upper volume 96 ft 8 in deep from Maryland St at levels 9-10 vs 90 ft)
Site permit application for Block 8, including Power Station Park East, submitted
2024 DA compliance report: Block 8 approximately 348 market-rate units; 'Developer has submitted no building permits for any market-rate housing projects'
JPMorgan Chase agrees to finance roughly $200 million for a 342-unit Foster + Partners-designed building at 151 Humboldt St
Construction expected to begin in fall 2026

Completion expected: SocketSite's October 2020 revised-phasing schedule lists Block 8 vertical development 2026-2028 (Phase 1) and SF YIMBY's March 2021 report anticipated completion in 2028; the August 2026 report of JPMorgan construction financing and a fall 2026 start gives no completion date, and no source since 2021 restates a 2028 completion
milestones.basis_note: Phase 1 in the October 2020 revised phasing, as reported by SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020), whose 'Re-Phase Program, Detailed Construction Schedule' table lists Block 8 vertical development 2026-2028; a stale press-reported forecast (the same 2020-21 articles had Blocks 7 and 15 completing by 2026, which did not happen), not a Block 8 commitment; the Chronicle (Aug 3, 2026) gives only a fall 2026 start.

open_questions: Address / parcel: the Chronicle gives Block 8 as 151 Humboldt St. Pier & Point's Block 2 record notes that blklot 4232022 (151 Humboldt St) sits roughly where the D4D places Block 8. Block 8 may therefore already have a subdivided Assessor parcel (4232022) that could replace this approximate polygon. Not verified against DataSF here; the map shape has not been revisited.

Unit count for the 2026 building (342) differs from the 2022 approval (339) and the compliance reports (348). Whether a revised design review or new site permit has been filed since May 2022 is not documented in the sources reviewed.

Architect: Stanley Saitowitz | Natoma Architects publishes a 'Potrero Power Block 8' concept ('initial thoughts to begin the process of developing a design for Block 8', architect's own material, undated). The Chronicle (Aug 2026) still credits Foster + Partners and uses its renderings. Not recorded as a fact; noted here only.

Height: the approved plan set shows 125 ft to the last occupied floor with mechanical screening to 145 ft; SF YIMBY reported 140 ft (2021) and 156 ft (2022). The note on this record's map shape ('140 ft vs. 156 ft') reflects the press figures, not the approval.

No construction start found. Searched the 2021-2024 compliance reports, SF YIMBY (Block 8 category, last item March 2022), the Chronicle and SF Standard. The Aug 2026 Chronicle says construction 'is expected to begin in the fall' of 2026; no groundbreaking report yet as of Sept 17, 2026.

An earlier version of this record's map-shape notes cited an unidentified SF OEWD pipeline document (355 units, March 2027 start, about $275M); it could not be located or verified and was removed on 2026-09-29.
No general contractor, total development cost, or ground-lease information for Block 8 in any source found (developer-owned land; no Port lease).

The 2028 completion figure comes from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Block 8 vertical development 2026-2028) and SF YIMBY's March 2021 report; no source since has restated a completion year for the 342-unit building financed in August 2026, so it is treated as a stale phase forecast rather than a current commitment.

On 2026-09-29 the Foster + Partners rendering previously shown here (sheet G-8-108-PL, PDF page 37 of the Design Review Approval) was removed because the sheet is marked (c) Foster + Partners 2020 and the SB 1214 authorization page grants permission to the Planning Department, not to third parties; the Design Review Approval stays linked in sources.

Has construction of Block 8 begun? As of 2026-10-10 no source read reports a groundbreaking, a start date, or a postponement; the August 2026 Chronicle report that construction is expected to begin in fall 2026 is the latest word found.
